fact: On 18 February 2026 the World Bank-financed HISWACA-SOP 2 project handed 300 motorcycles (357 million FCFA) to school sector chiefs to supervise and speed the collection and transmission of school data for the education statistics system, so that statistical yearbooks can be produced regularly.

ICASEES published on 15 November 2024 the statistical yearbook for pre-school, Fondamental 1 and non-formal basic education, covering school year 2021-2022, from the 2022 statistical campaign of all schools.
